sources.answer:
DOCS\_NOT\_COVERED

The pages establish Pacific Mainnet (`eip155:1672`), provide the RPC endpoint, identify `0xc879c018db60520f4355c26ed1a6d572cdac1815` as the USDC contract address, and document generic `eth_getCode` and `eth_call` requests. See [x402 Pacific Mainnet](/developer-guide/x402/x402-pacific-mainnet) and [JSON-RPC API Methods](/api-and-sdk/json-rpc-methods).

They do **not** explicitly document the ERC-20 calls `name`, `symbol`, `decimals`, or `balanceOf`, or provide their calldata or ABI. So these pages alone don’t fully specify how to inspect the token metadata and wallet balance without assuming method semantics.
